regime_context: The detector shows a dominant, one-narrative Oil & Gas Producers theme (XEG.TO) with high breadth (0.929) and high durability (0.71), but a crowded flag (z=1.19) and a narrowing rotation (only 6 of 16 themes eligible). The rank is a focus lens, not a forecast; the only validated edge here is the absolute-trend gate, which does help this market's history (gate_helps=true). Track record shows modest directional accuracy (0.324), so conviction stays low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Pipelines & Midstream (unscorable, eligible, trend-tag, durability 0.71) can hold eligibility while Oil & Gas stays crowded — if energy leadership broadens into midstream, the crowding concentration in XEG may be absorbing rather than topping; retire this watch if Pipelines falls out of eligible status or XEG's breadth drops below 0.6.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas is the eligible, trend-gate-passing leader with strong coherence (one_narrative=true, breadth 0.929) and high durability (0.71). I lean with the trend discipline rather than against it; the absolute-trend gate is the one validated leg and XEG is on the right side of it. Crowding (z=1.19) is a size-down caution, not a reason to fade — but it caps my conviction.
theses.dissent: Energy leadership in Canada is historically fragile to a sudden global risk-off or a sharp crude reversal; the crowded flag means positioning is stretched and a shake-out would hit this theme hardest exactly because it is the concentrated leader.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO closes below its 50-day moving average for five consecutive sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks are eligible with a trend hurst_tag, decent durability (0.63), and meaningful breadth (0.429) — the only other clearly coherent, non-crowded, trend-gate-passing theme alongside Oil & Gas. In a narrowing rotation, the trend discipline favours staying with confirmed eligible leaders rather than reaching for challengers.
theses.dissent: Banks are rate-sensitive and a Canadian housing/credit stress event would hit them before the trend gate could turn; the leadership gap to Oil & Gas is large (score 0.635 vs 1.91) and the theme lacks the one-narrative cohesion of energy.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO underperforms XEG.TO by more than 200 basis points over any rolling two-week window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners are the rotation challenger on raw score (rank=2) but are NOT eligible — the absolute-trend gate rejects them. Given the gate is the one validated edge on this market's history, I avoid a theme that fails the staying-power test even though it shows rank momentum. Chasing the challenger before a confirmed handoff is the documented failure mode.
theses.dissent: If the rotation is real and oil leadership cracks, Gold Miners could be the next confirmed leader and avoiding it would miss the handoff; the raw score (1.015) is the only challenger within striking distance.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO becomes eligible on the trend gate AND rotation.leader changes to ca_gold before the check-by date
